text: Oh...I panicked for a sec because of the Coenubias\nin the water, but good thing they disappear if we\npop the bubble and expose them to the water...
Hm, but the fact that they can get underwater\nmeans they're becoming resistant to water to some\nextent, right?
Whoa...The Coenubias have already started to gain\nresistance to water just by coming to a slightly\ndeeper zone.
Just how fast do they mutate and evolve?!
Oh my goshhh! Nothing happens even when they're\nsoaking wet! These things are mutating and\nevolving like crazy~!!
Although they're no longer weak to water, it\ndoesn't change the fact that they're Coenubias...
W-well, despite being no longer weak to water,\nthey don't seem to have got stronger. I guess\nwe'll just need to take them down steadily...
